# src/ — implementation

## Purpose

All hub code. Rust standard library only; zero external crates is a hard
constraint, so JSON, HTTP and the browser page are in-tree and unit-tested.

## Ownership

| File | Owns |
| --- | --- |
| `main.rs` | CLI surface: `serve`, `bin put/ls/get/rm`, `snapshot`, `doctor`, `version`. Flag parsing, data-dir and bind policy live here. |
| `lib.rs` | Module registry and `DEFAULT_PORT`. Keep the module list minimal. |
| `server.rs` | Route table, snapshot cache (2.5 s TTL), pastebin HTTP handlers, `State`. |
| `sources.rs` | The only place that shells out. `Sources::detect` resolves the CLIs; `collect` returns machines, sessions and per-source health. Herdr and Orca parsing lives in private helpers here. |
| `model.rs` | Wire types and their JSON shape. `Snapshot::to_json` computes `counts` (sessions, working, machines, bins). |
| `bins.rs` | Pastebin store: one JSON file per bin, atomic write via temp+rename, id validation, size caps. |
| `exec.rs` | `resolve` (env → known paths → PATH) and `run` (argv only, hard timeout, kill on overrun, concurrent pipe readers). |
| `http.rs` | In-tree HTTP/1.1 server: request parsing, keep-alive, response writing, security headers. 32 KiB head / 1 MiB body caps. |
| `json.rs` | Strict depth-limited JSON parser and serializer. |
| `util.rs` | Time, percent encode/decode, query parsing, `clamp`, `clean_text` (ANSI/control stripping). |

## Invariants

1. **No command strings.** Every CLI call is `(program, &[args])`; never `sh -c`.
2. **No unbounded waits.** `exec::run` always takes a `Duration`; the child is killed
   and its pipes drained on timeout.
3. **Sources never panic the request.** A failing CLI becomes a `SourceStatus { ok: false }`
   plus an unavailable machine row; the rest of the snapshot still renders.
4. **One local machine row.** Orca and Herdr both describe the local box; `collect`
   merges same-name machines instead of duplicating them.
5. **Bins are dumb bytes with caps.** `MAX_BODY` 256 KiB, `MAX_BINS` 400, ids are
   `[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,80}`, and reads resolve only inside `bins/`.
6. **The page embeds no network dependency.** `assets/index.html` is `include_str!`d;
   its CSP is `default-src 'none'` with inline script/style allowed.

## Work Guidance

- Add a source by extending `Sources::collect` with a private `collect_*` method that
  pushes `Machine`/`Session`/`SourceStatus`; keep per-call timeouts ≤ 6 s.
- Keep `Session.detail` ≤ 600 characters after `clean_text`.
- Prefer small pure helpers (`nested`, `s`, `non_null`) over deep `match` ladders when
  reading third-party JSON; the field names are not ours.
- When a CLI shape changes, adjust the adapter and add a fixture-based unit test rather
  than loosening the parser.

## Verification

- `cargo test` — `bins` roundtrip + path traversal, `util` decoding/ANSI stripping,
  `json` escapes/limits, `http` request parsing, `server` route smoke test.
- `cargo build --release` with no warnings.
- `wtf-live doctor` against a live Orca and Herdr.
